metadata.title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models: Non-linearity, Sparsity, and Attention-Sink-Free

atomic_comments.content: The paper lacks a detailed theoretical analysis of the effect of gating and the low-rank linear projection's impact on performance.
atomic_comments.anchor_quote: missing a detailed theoretical analysis of the effect of gating

atomic_comments.content: The paper does not compare the proposed method with other gating methods like Switch Heads, NSA, and MoSA.
atomic_comments.anchor_quote: does not compare the proposed method with other gating methods

atomic_comments.content: The paper lacks detailed analysis of how gating affects performance on different tasks and datasets.
atomic_comments.anchor_quote: does not provide a detailed analysis of the effect of gating on the model's performance

atomic_comments.content: The paper does not provide a detailed analysis of how gating affects training stability and reduces loss spikes.
atomic_comments.anchor_quote: does not provide a detailed analysis of the effect of gating on the model's training stability

atomic_comments.content: The paper lacks detailed analysis of how gating affects attention dynamics and reduces the attention sink.
atomic_comments.anchor_quote: does not provide a detailed analysis of the effect of gating on the model's attention dynamics
